title: AI-Based System for Assessing Health and Moisture Content of Concrete
summary: Mbeya University of Science and Technology is developing AI models that assess concrete cracks and moisture from images and sensor data; no field result is reported.

account: Mbeya University of Science and Technology, in Tanzania, has validated the concept of an AI system that assesses concrete cracks and moisture from images and sensor data. data.answer:
MUST is developing image and sensor models for concrete cracks and moisture. Field maintenance, safety, and material-saving benefits remain intended.

No field maintenance action, avoided structural failure, or measured material saving is reported. Crack classification and moisture regression need validation against engineering ground truth across sites. Planned construction-firm pilots cannot establish longer infrastructure life or public safety benefits.

The account does not separately assess AI’s contribution to the benefit.
